# GitHub Copilot instructions — EMOPET

Before substantive suggestions or edits, read:

- `AI_READ_FIRST.md`
- `AGENTS.md`

## Mandatory scientific context

If the task touches C-BARQ, University of Pennsylvania / Penn Vet, James A. Serpell, ELI scientific validation, canine behaviour, behavioural questionnaires, longitudinal validation, or sensor-to-behaviour interpretation, read in full:

`docs/science/EMOPET_CBARQ_UPENN_SCIENTIFIC_AUTHORITY_2026-09-23.md`

Do not:

- infer a C-BARQ licence from open-access publication;
- reproduce C-BARQ items without explicit permission;
- treat the French-study 63-item EFA result as a validated short form;
- collapse MISSING / NOT_APPLICABLE / NOT_OBSERVED to zero;
- map sensor activity directly to fear/aggression/anxiety/diagnosis;
- imply Penn or James Serpell endorsement;
- describe ELI as validated against C-BARQ unless a controlled validation record supersedes the current authority.

When in doubt, preserve uncertainty, provenance, versioning, abstention and the distinction between observation, interpretation and diagnosis.
